privacy.metaDesc: How A. Subramaniam collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.p: When you fill a form, call or message, we may collect your name, phone number, email and details of your enquiry. The help assistant only keeps anonymous counts of which topics are opened, with no personal details.
Only to reply to your enquiry and to help with the insurance or property services you ask about. We do not sell your information or use it for unrelated marketing.
With your consent, details may be shared with the relevant insurer to process a proposal or claim.
Enquiries are stored securely with Supabase (database) and sent to us as an email alert through Resend. Only the advisor can see them.
We keep your enquiry only as long as it is needed to help you, and delete it when it is no longer needed or when you ask.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your information at any time by contacting us.
For privacy questions, please use the contact page.

sections.p: This website gives general information about insurance and property services offered by A. Subramaniam.
Information here is general guidance only. It is not a quote, an offer or policy advice. Cover is subject to the insurer's policy terms.
Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Please read the policy wording and sales brochure carefully before buying.
Listing details are shared in good faith. Please verify documents, approvals and prices before any purchase.
These terms may be updated from time to time. The latest version will be on this page.

claims.intro: Here are the general steps. Every insurer has its own process, so call Mr. Subramaniam when you need to make a claim.

steps: Show your health card and ID at the hospital's insurance desk.
The hospital sends a pre-authorisation request to the insurer.
Once approved, the insurer pays the hospital directly as per policy terms.
Pay the hospital and keep every original bill and report.
Fill in the claim form and send it with the documents.
The insurer checks the claim and pays as per policy terms.
